summary: Airborne countermeasures dispenser system: RR-170A/AL chaff and MJU-7/B MTV flare cartridges, cued by RWR and missile warning

chaff_count.note: 1 standard 30-round AN/ALE-47 magazine loaded with 1x1x8 in RR-170A/AL chaff cartridges

flare_count.note: 1 standard 30-slot AN/ALE-47 magazine loaded with 15 double-width 1x2x8 in MJU-7/B MTV IR flares

flare_life_s.note: MJU-7/B MTV pyrotechnic cartridge nominal burn duration (3.5-5.0 s)

flare_rise_s.note: MJU-7/B squib ignition rise to peak MWIR radiant intensity

flare_mass_kg.note: MJU-7/B MTV pyrotechnic pellet mass at ejection

flare_burned_mass_kg.note: Residual slag and case mass at burnout

flare_drag_area_m2.note: Mean tumbling Cd*A for 2.5x5x20 cm burning MJU-7/B grain (Cauchy mean 0.0084 m^2 x Cd 0.70 with combustion base bleed)

flare_peak_intensity_w_sr.note: MJU-7/B 3-5 um MWIR peak radiant intensity

flare_core_radius_m.note: Peak MTV combustion flame core radius radiometrically consistent with 6500 W/sr MWIR at 2150 K

flare_eject_speed_m_s.note: BBU-36/B squib ejection velocity relative to airframe

chaff_life_s.note: RR-170A/AL dipole cloud effective scattering lifetime in upper-air wind

chaff_bloom_time_s.note: Aerodynamic wake bloom time constant for RR-170A/AL dipoles

chaff_peak_rcs_m2.note: RR-170A/AL multi-cut Al-glass dipole X-band monostatic peak RCS

chaff_center_freq_hz.note: Half-wave dipole cut resonance center around X-band

chaff_drag_coeff_m2_kg.note: High-speed aerodynamic deceleration factor for 25 um Al-glass dipoles

chaff_terminal_sink_m_s.note: Dipole filament gravitational terminal settling speed at sea level

chaff_eject_speed_m_s.note: BBU-35/B squib ejection velocity relative to airframe
